newsitem.title: CHINA: Diesel Engine acquires Yangzhou plant.
newsitem.headline: Diesel Engine acquires Yangzhou plant.

text.p: Shanghai Diesel Engine Co Ltd has acquired 51 percent of shares in a diesel engine plant in Yangzhou in the eastern province of Jiangsu, a company statement said on Monday.
The statement said Shanghai Diesel Engine had spent 53.55 million yuan to buy 37.82 million shares at 1.416 yuan per share in Yangzhou Xinxing Energy Co.
Shanghai Diesel Engine bought the shares with the aim of expanding output of diesel engines, the statement said.
The Yangzhou plant has 3,700 workers and an annual capacity to produce 280,000 diesel engines, it said but gave no more details. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
